Option C is slightly less specific by omitting 'Primary B-cell' and 'of the iris'. Option B is less specific by only mentioning 'Primary B-cell lymphoma of the iris (CD20+)' without specifying the MALT subtype. Option A is the least specific, only stating 'Primary iris B-cell lymphoma' without the CD20+ detail or MALT subtype.
